profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at BinderMind
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and Sports Data Analyst/Engineer with experience building data-driven tools, analytics platforms, and workflow solutions across both sports and VFX industries.

Currently a Full Stack Developer with BinderMind.

Previously worked at Tippett Studio developing tools and plugins for applications including Houdini, Maya, Nuke, Blender, ZBrush, and Unreal Engine 5.

Outside of professional work, I’ve developed several basketball analytics projects including machine learning models for NBA and WNBA award predictions, scouting dashboards, draft analysis tools, and statistical visualizations focused on player and team performance.

Passionate about using data to uncover competitive advantages and help organizations make smarter basketball decisions.

GitHub: github.com/Ivan-Garcia-S

projects.title: 2025 NBA Draft Hub
projects.description:
Developed a React App that acts as a Draft Hub for the 2025 NBA Draft. The end users for this application are the Front Office decision makers who will be making the selections at the NBA Draft.
There is a big board with basic info and rankings for each prospect as well as a personal player page for each prospect with in-depth stats and metrics.

projects.title: Jeremiah Wilkinson Assist/Turnover Improvement
projects.description: Developed a personalized analytics project for Cal Freshman Guard Jeremiah Wilkinson focused on improving his Assist-to-Turnover (A/TOV) ratio. Proactively reached out to him and conducted an in-depth analysis based on his performance priorities. Collected data by reviewing game film, created detailed visualizations, and provided actionable insights in a comprehensive summary.
